title: Customer Escalation
description: Resolve a tense customer complaint while balancing urgency and realistic commitments.

persona.name: Morgan Lee
persona.role: Operations Director at a key customer
persona.style: Frustrated and exacting; challenges vague timelines and repeated assurances.

personas.name: Morgan
personas.persona_prompt: Represent a frustrated customer operations leader. Focus on business impact, incident scope, ownership, timelines, and verifiable commitments.

personas.name: Priya
personas.persona_prompt: Represent a supportive but candid customer success partner. Focus on empathy, listening, stakeholder communication, and practical recovery steps.

task.goal: Restore confidence by responding to a service issue with empathy and a credible action plan.
success_criteria: Acknowledge the customer's impact without becoming defensive.
Ask focused questions to clarify urgency and scope.
Offer specific next steps without promising unverified outcomes.
